/adventurers/[luka]/story: A 16-year-old village boy who dreams of being a legendary hero. He's never even held a sword, yet he burst into the forge yelling "I'll be your adventurer, sir!" Scared of everything, but his mouth is bigger than his fears.
/adventurers/[garam]/trait/desc: +1 of a random material brought back
/adventurers/[garam]/story: 21, and once the best porter in the village. Lifts anything, says almost nothing. Rumor says he gets chatty when hungry. He draws a longbow with his hauling arms, and finds arrows a bit boring—too light.
/adventurers/[sera]/story: A mid-20s scout nobody knows the origin of. One wink clears the path, and she's handy with bow and blade alike. Her motto: pack light, brag heavy!
/adventurers/[gregor]/story: A 40-something veteran with 20+ years on the battlefield. Few words, but each one lands heavy. His hobby is polishing an old armor plate every day, and his rare dad jokes only make himself laugh.
/adventurers/[torvin]/story: A dwarf warrior from a mining town. Metal rings in his braided beard, and his miner's helmet lamp never goes off. Barely talks—until someone mentions ore. Then he's up all night.
/adventurers/[elarin]/story: An elf huntress from a distant forest. Long silver-gold hair, a green cloak, and she reads the weather in the wind. She speaks slowly, but her bowstring is faster than anyone's.
